_readme: Tag allowlist for Instagram and TikTok. See README.md in this folder. Only brands, products and companies; never people. A handle is tagged only with verified=true and a checked date in the last 30 days.

japan.note: Visit Japan: the destination brand of JNTO, Japan's official tourism board (CoS, 2026-09-27)

instagram.evidence: instagram.com public profile data for visitjapan.us: full_name 'Visit Japan / Americas', is_verified true, business account, 139,609 followers, posts on 2026-09-20/24/26, bio 'Official JNTO Americas account'; JNTO's own sites (japan.travel/en/us, jnto.go.jp/eng) link instagram.com/visitjapan.us. @visitjapanus (no dot) is not JNTO's: Instagram's lookup returns 404.

tiktok.evidence: tiktok.com/@k18hair profile data: uniqueId k18hair, nickname K18 Hair, verified true (fetched 2026-09-27); k18hair.com TikTok contest rules name @k18hair as the brand account

hermès.note: Hermès, the Paris fashion house; concept pair fashion -> hermès (Soul's taste pass, 2026-09-27)

instagram.evidence: official: Wikidata Q843887 lists Instagram username 'hermes' (https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q843887) and Hermès's LinkedIn company page links instagram.com/hermes; verified: the indexed profile page instagram.com/hermes shows the Verified badge, 15.5M followers, bio 'Hermès, contemporary artisan since 1837.'; posted in the last 7 days: HypeAuditor's daily table has 3,497 posts on 21 Sep 2026 (https://hypeauditor.com/fr/instagram/hermes/) and Social Blade shows 3,500 on 27 Sep 2026 (https://socialblade.com/instagram/user/hermes), so 3 posts after 21 Sep. Global: Hermès's single worldwide account, picked by the founder.
